 What is AUX And how this Headphone Work

 If you plug speakers or mics or headsets into a primary device , with the possible exception of some types of USB setups, you’re typically connecting in through what you would call an auxiliary port.

 Computer port (COM1) on a traditional PC is typically configured as an audio aux port. which is the first serial port with a preconfigured assignment for serial devices.

 An RS 232 standardization applies to various PC audio attachments, many of which are converted to the 3.5mm or 1/8 inch standard audio jack on a lot of peripheral hardware.

 Generally, the use of these audio ports requires different types of adapters and fittings for backward compatibility as system components evolve from many different manufacturers.

 Can USB-C headphones provide better sound quality? 

 A quick recap:

 
• 
 DACs convert digital signals to analog sound

• 
 Analog cable runs are more susceptible to signal degradation

 
 The key to improving sound quality minimizing the distance which analog signals need to travel along a cable, which is exactly what USB C headphones with a built-in DAC do.

 When you plug a pair of premium USB C headphones into your phone, the phone’s internal DAC is bypassed and the audio signals travel along the headphone’s cable in digital format to the headphones built in DAC.

 From here, the DAC performs the usual digital to analog conversion, with the converted analog signal only needing to travel a matter to centimeters to reach the headphone drivers. This greatly reduces the potential for signal degradation, and is the biggest advantage of USB C headphones.

 In-Ear Headphones

 Sometimes called earphones or “earbuds”, in-ear headphones are perhaps the most common type of headphone today. The white “earpods” that come in the box with every new Android have made them a must-have accessory. On their way out the door to class, the average college student likely makes sure they have their keys, wallet, cell phone, and earbuds.

 What is AUX Port 

 A socket for plugging in an audio source. Audio jacks are found on many types of audio equipment and musical instruments that accept external sound sources. In a car or truck, an audio jack, also called a “media jack” or “auxiliary (AUX) jack,” is a mini-phone socket that connects any portable music player to the vehicle’s amplifier and speakers. One end of a mini-phone cable plugs into the headphones socket of any CD, tape cassette or digital music player, and the other end plugs into the car’s audio jack. An iPod can be hooked up in this manner as well, but there are also adapters designed strictly for the iPod (see MP3 car adapter and iPod car adapter). See jack and A/V ports.

 Phone and mini-phone sockets are the traditional audio jacks. The jacks are the sockets, not the plugs.

Experience seamless audio streaming from your devices without any interruptions. Pairing is quick and easy; just take the earbuds out of the charging case, and they automatically connect to your device. Enjoy the freedom of wireless listening for up to 30 feet!

 Comfort is essential for anyone who enjoys long listening sessions. The Onikuma T305 TWS Bluetooth earbuds are designed to fit snugly in your ears without causing discomfort. •

•

Whether you’re hitting the gym or caught in a light rain, you can rest assured that your earbuds are protected from the elements. Enjoy music anytime, anywhere with confidence!

 Touch Controls for Ultimate Convenience

 The Onikuma T305 TWS Bluetooth earbuds come equipped with touch controls, which allow you to effortlessly manage your music and calls without reaching for your device. Skip tracks, adjust volume, or answer calls with simple taps, providing you with a truly hands-free experience.

 In a crowded market of wireless earbuds, the Onikuma T305 TWS Bluetooth earbuds stand out for their combination of performance, comfort, and affordability. Whether you're using them for casual listening, workouts, or professional calls, these earbuds deliver on all fronts. Each detail is thoughtfully designed to enhance your user experience and take your audio enjoyment to the next level.

 If you're looking for quality sound, comfort, and versatility in a pair of wireless earbuds, look no further than the Onikuma T305 TWS Bluetooth earbuds. With their superior performance and user-friendly features, they are the perfect accessory for anyone who values high-quality audio on the go.

 Don’t miss out on elevating your audio experience! Order your Onikuma T305 TWS Bluetooth earbuds today and discover the difference for yourself!

Lightweight Comfort and Clear Audio: Sades Spirits SA-721 Stereo Wired Gaming Headset - MultiColor
 Level up your gaming with the Sades Spirits SA-721 Stereo Wired Gaming Headset - MultiColor —a budget-friendly headset designed for vibrant style and reliable performance across platforms. Equipped with 50mm drivers, it delivers punchy stereo sound, ideal for casual gaming or music, with decent bass for gunshots or melee effects, as noted in a 2021 Thumb Culture review. The flexible omnidirectional microphone ensures clear voice pickup for Discord or in-game chats, while the lightweight 220g frame and soft leather earpads offer comfort during long sessions. With a 3.5mm jack, Y-cable for PC, and controls on the left earcup, it’s versatile for PS4, Xbox One (2015), Switch, or mobile devices. Available in bold MultiColor options like pink or cyan, this headset adds a playful aesthetic to any setup—perfect for gamers seeking affordability, ease, and a pop of personality.
 Key Features
 
• 50mm Stereo Drivers: Deliver clear, balanced audio with notable bass—suitable for games like Fortnite or music, though treble may need EQ tweaks on PC for optimal clarity, as per Thumb Culture.

• Flexible Omnidirectional Mic: Picks up voice with decent clarity for team chats—crisp but not studio-grade, ideal for casual gaming, though some users report slight distortion.

• Lightweight 220g Design: Adjustable headband and skin-friendly leather earpads—ensures comfort for hours, even for glasses wearers, as praised in an Amazon.ca review for online training use.

• Multi-Platform Compatibility: 3.5mm jack supports PS4, Xbox One (2015, adapter not included), Switch, PC (via Y-cable), laptops, and mobile devices—plug-and-play for broad versatility.

• Convenient Earcup Controls: Volume wheel and mic mute button on the left earcup—allows on-the-fly adjustments without breaking focus, enhancing usability during intense matches.

• Vibrant MultiColor Options: Available in eye-catching colors like pink, cyan, or white—adds a bold, customizable aesthetic to desks, appealing to younger gamers or colorful setups.

• Durable Build for Budget: Hard-wearing headband and leather muffs—offers surprising quality for a budget headset, though durability concerns were raised in a 2021 Amazon UK review after four months.

compume-c5y7ah.description:
The UGREEN EP106 (35756) are premium wired semi-in-ear earphones with a USB-C connector — delivering the largest driver in UGREEN's wired earphones lineup at 14.2mm, a professional-grade Knowles HD microphone, an aluminium alloy sound chamber, and an extended 20Hz–40kHz frequency response — all in a lightweight semi-in-ear design built for all-day wearing comfort. For users who find fully sealed in-ear earphones uncomfortable during extended use, the EP106's semi-in-ear design provides hours of fatigue-free wearing while the 14.2mm driver and aluminium chamber deliver acoustic performance that exceeds what the EP105's 10mm driver can achieve.

 

 14.2MM DYNAMIC DRIVER — THE LARGEST IN UGREEN'S WIRED EARPHONE RANGE

 The EP106's 14.2mm dynamic driver is 42% larger in diameter than the EP105's 10mm driver — a significant acoustic engineering difference with direct impact on sound quality. A larger driver diaphragm moves more air volume per excursion, producing:

 - Deeper, more impactful bass extension without distortion at high volume

 - Fuller, more natural midrange body with greater vocal and instrument presence

 - Cleaner high-frequency reproduction with reduced resonance artefacts

 - A wider perceived soundstage — the increased driver excursion area creates more convincing stereo separation between left and right channels

 

 The 14.2mm driver's extended frequency response of 20Hz–40kHz — reaching twice the standard 20kHz upper limit — captures ultrasonic harmonic content from Hi-Res Audio recordings, delivering additional air and overtone detail that 20kHz-limited earphones cannot reproduce.

 

 ALUMINIUM ALLOY SOUND CHAMBER — ACOUSTIC RESONANCE CONTROL

 The aluminium alloy sound chamber surrounding the 14.2mm driver provides precise internal acoustic geometry — controlling resonance and frequency reflection within the housing to reinforce bass body, maintain midrange clarity, and suppress housing-generated colouration. Aluminium's rigidity eliminates the flex vibration that plastic housings introduce at high volumes, and its thermal conductivity dissipates driver-generated heat efficiently — maintaining consistent acoustic performance during extended listening sessions. CNC precision manufacturing ensures consistent chamber dimensions across production units.

 

 SEMI-IN-EAR DESIGN — EXTENDED WEAR WITHOUT PRESSURE FATIGUE

 Unlike fully sealed in-ear earphones that create an acoustic seal within the ear canal, the EP106's semi-in-ear design rests at the canal entrance without insertion — providing a naturally comfortable fit for extended continuous use during commutes, workdays, and gym sessions. The lightweight semi-in-ear housing distributes weight across the outer ear rather than concentrating it at the canal — eliminating the canal pressure and occlusion fatigue that makes fully sealed earphones uncomfortable after extended wear. The ergonomic housing shape follows the natural contour of the outer ear for a secure, stable fit without silicone tip dependency.

 

 KNOWLES HD MICROPHONE — PROFESSIONAL-GRADE VOICE CAPTURE

 The EP106 is equipped with a Knowles HD microphone — a component from Knowles Corporation, the global leader in professional balanced armature and MEMS microphone manufacturing. Knowles microphones are used in professional hearing aids, recording equipment, and premium consumer earphones — delivering significantly higher sensitivity, lower self-noise, and more accurate frequency response than generic ECM microphone capsules used in standard earphones. The Knowles HD mic captures voice with precision while actively filtering background noise — producing clear, natural call audio in office, commute, and outdoor environments.

 

 3-BUTTON INLINE CONTROLLER — COMPLETE MEDIA & CALL MANAGEMENT

 The in-line 3-button controller provides full hands-free management:

 - Volume up button: Increase playback volume

 - Volume down button: Decrease playback volume

 - Centre MFB (single press): Play / Pau

Compact and Reliable Audio with the Fantech Mithril TX-1 Lite True Wireless Earbuds Experience freedom in sound with the Fantech Mithril TX-1 Lite True Wireless Earbuds —a sleek, budget-friendly audio solution that brings crisp tunes and reliable performance to your daily grind. Featuring 13mm drivers for balanced bass and treble, Bluetooth 5.1 for stable wireless connectivity, and an IPX4 sweat-resistant design, these earbuds are built for active lifestyles, from gym sessions to casual strolls. With up to 20 hours of total battery life (via the case), touch controls for easy operation, and a lightweight 42g build, the Mithril TX-1 Lite delivers Fantech’s signature quality in a minimalist package. Available in stealthy Black, they’re perfect for music lovers, mobile gamers, or anyone seeking wire-free convenience without breaking the bank—your sound, untethered and ready to roll. Key Features • Custom-Tuned 13mm Drivers: Precision-engineered 13mm speakers deliver clear highs, smooth mids, and satisfying bass—optimized for a quality listening experience that punches above its price class, though without the thunderous depth of premium models. • Bluetooth 5.1 Connectivity: A stable, low-latency connection pairs effortlessly with your devices over a 10-meter range—ideal for music, calls, or lag-free mobile gaming, with automatic reconnection to the last paired device. • IPX4 Sweat & Splash Resistance: Built to withstand workouts, light rain, or outdoor adventures, these earbuds keep performing through sweat and splashes—perfect for those always on the move. • Up to 20-Hour Playtime: Enjoy 5 hours per charge from the earbuds, plus 15 more from the 300mAh case—a quick 1-hour USB-C recharge keeps you powered up for a full day’s use. • Touch Controls & Voice Assistant: Tap to play, pause, skip tracks, manage calls, or summon your phone’s assistant (Siri, Google)—intuitive operation without reaching for your device, though no volume control is included. • Ergonomic & Lightweight: At just 4g per earbud and 42g with the case, they twist snugly into your ears with three ear tip sizes (S, M, L) for a secure, comfy fit—designed to stay put without fatigue. • Sleek Black Design: The understated Black finish offers a clean, versatile look—simple yet stylish, blending into any vibe while keeping the focus on sound and function. whiteangel-11uhqsn.description:
REDRAGON H231 SCREAM – Balanced Gaming Audio with Comfort and Style 

 Immersive Sound That Keeps You in Control 

 The REDRAGON H231 SCREAM is designed to give you a clear and consistent audio experience that enhances your gameplay without overcomplicating things. Equipped with high-quality 40mm drivers, this headset delivers well-balanced stereo sound with enough depth to make explosions feel powerful while still keeping footsteps and subtle details clear. This balance is especially important for competitive gaming, where hearing small movements can make a real difference in performance.

 Whether you’re playing fast-paced FPS games, open-world adventures, or even casual online matches, the H231 provides stable and reliable sound that helps you stay focused. It’s tuned for practical use rather than exaggerated effects, making it suitable for both gaming and general multimedia like videos and music.

 Lightweight Comfort for Long Gaming Sessions 

 Comfort is one of the strongest points of the REDRAGON H231 SCREAM. The headset features a lightweight design that reduces pressure on the head, allowing you to play for extended periods without discomfort. The ear cushions are made from soft leather-style material combined with foam padding, which provides a snug fit while also helping with passive noise isolation.

 The adjustable headband ensures the headset fits securely on different head sizes without feeling too tight or too loose. This makes it a great option for gamers who spend long hours playing and need something that won’t cause fatigue. The overall design focuses on simplicity and usability, making it practical for daily use.

 Clear Communication with Noise-Reducing Microphone 

 A good microphone is essential for team-based gaming, and the H231 SCREAM delivers solid performance in this area. It comes with a flexible, adjustable boom microphone that allows you to position it exactly where you need it. The microphone is designed to reduce background noise and focus on your voice, ensuring that your teammates hear you clearly during gameplay.

 This feature is especially useful in competitive environments where communication speed and clarity can impact the outcome of a match. It’s also suitable for voice calls, online meetings, or streaming setups where consistent voice quality is important.

 Clean RGB Lighting for a Modern Gaming Look 

 The headset includes built-in RGB lighting that adds a stylish touch to your gaming setup. The lighting is subtle and clean, giving the headset a modern gaming appearance without being too distracting. It pairs well with RGB keyboards, mice, and other accessories, helping you create a unified and visually appealing setup.

 While RGB doesn’t affect performance, it plays a big role in overall presentation, especially for gamers who care about the look of their desk or streaming environment.

 Wide Compatibility Across Multiple Platforms 

 One of the key advantages of the REDRAGON H231 SCREAM is its compatibility with a wide range of devices. It works seamlessly with PCs, laptops, PlayStation consoles, and many Xbox controllers, as well as mobile devices and the Nintendo Switch. This makes it a flexible option for users who switch between platforms.

 The wired connection ensures stable performance with no latency or signal drops, which is important for gaming where timing and responsiveness matter. You simply plug it in and start using it without needing additional setup or software.

 Built for Everyday Gaming and Practical Use 

 This headset is made for users who want reliable performance without paying for unnecessary extras. It focuses on delivering the essentials: clear sound, good microphone quality, and comfortable design. This makes it ideal for entry-level to mid-range gaming setups, as well as for users who want a dependable headset for daily use.

 It’s also a strong choice for stores and sellers looking for a product that offers good value and appeals to a wide audience.

compume-r4ttn5.description:
Brand: Onikuma | Model: K19 | Color: Black | Type: Wired Gaming Headset
 The Onikuma K19 is a full-size wired gaming headset designed for players who need clear audio, reliable communication, and all-session comfort. The over-ear design features padded leatherette ear cushions and an adjustable cushioned headband, reducing fatigue during extended play.
 
• 
 RGB LED Lighting: The earcup panels display a multicolor RGB glow with an illuminated Onikuma character graphic, adding a distinctive look to any gaming setup.

• 
 Noise-Cancelling Microphone: A flexible boom microphone filters out background noise, keeping your voice clear during team communication in multiplayer games or voice calls.

• 
 Stereo Sound: Large drivers deliver detailed stereo audio, helping you pick up directional cues, in-game effects, and dialogue accurately.

• 
 Wired Connection with Inline Controls: The braided cable includes an inline control box for quick volume adjustment and mic mute. The package includes both a USB connector (for RGB power) and a dual 3.5 mm audio splitter cable for broad compatibility.

• 
 Wide Device Compatibility: Works with PC, laptop, PS4, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, and mobile devices via the 3.5 mm audio jack.

• 
 What's in the Box: K19 headset, USB LED power cable, dual 3.5 mm splitter cable, and user guide.

 The K19 suits gamers looking for a straightforward, feature-complete headset at an accessible price point — no drivers or software installation required.

whiteangel-1sx1njm.description:
Redragon H320W Lamia 2 White 7.1 Surround Sound RGB Gaming Headset

 The Redragon H320W Lamia 2 White 7.1 Surround Sound RGB Gaming Headset is an exceptional audio solution crafted for competitive gamers, streamers, and setup minimalists who demand immersive spatial audio, pristine voice transmission, and a striking white aesthetic. Powered by custom-tuned dynamic drivers and an integrated USB 7.1 virtual surround sound card, the Lamia 2 converts subtle in-game acoustic details—such as quiet enemy footsteps, weapon reloads, and distant environmental sounds—into precise directional audio cues that give you an undisputed competitive advantage in fast-paced firefights.

 Meticulously engineered to complement modern white-themed PC battle stations and live streaming spaces, the Redragon H320W Lamia 2 pairs high-grade audio fidelity with complete setup convenience. Featuring vibrant RGB Chroma earcup backlighting, ultra-soft memory foam cushions, a built-in flexible microphone, and a dedicated bundled headset stand right out of the box, this headset delivers the long-lasting physical comfort, crystal-clear team communication, and sleek visual style needed to master long gaming marathons.

 
 
 
 
 Immersive Virtual 7.1 Surround Sound Engine

 High-Precision Positional Audio Core for Ultimate Tactical Awareness

 At the heart of the Redragon H320W Lamia 2 is an advanced built-in USB 7.1 virtual surround sound audio engine paired with high-performance dynamic drivers. This powerful acoustic configuration produces a wide multi-channel spatial soundstage with deep bass resonance, clear mid-tones, and detailed high frequencies, allowing you to accurately pinpoint enemy locations before they appear on your screen.

 Whether you are making rapid counter-strafing plays in tactical FPS shooter titles like Valorant and Counter-Strike 2, or immersing yourself in sprawling open-world RPG environments, the Lamia 2 delivers balanced, distortion-free audio depth across every gaming session.

 
 Pristine Pure White Aesthetic & RGB Chroma Illumination

 Vibrant Earcup Backlighting Engineered for White Setup Enthusiasts

 Stand out from traditional dark peripherals with the H320W’s sleek, pure white chassis finish . The clean outer shell is illuminated by dynamic RGB Chroma backlighting embedded directly into the earcup outer grilles, adding an eye-catching aesthetic glow to your setup during live streams or late-night gaming sessions.

 The dynamic color transitions inject vibrant energy onto your desk, seamlessly matching your white PC chassis, mechanical keyboard, and desktop accessories for a unified setup theme.

 
 Bundled Dedicated Headset Stand Included

 Keep Your Desk Organized and Protect Your Headset Between Matches

 The Redragon H320W Lamia 2 package includes a dedicated, high-quality standalone desktop headset holder . This sleek accessory provides a safe, stable resting spot for your headset when not in use, protecting the headband and ear pads from accidental desk scratches or wire tangles.

 By eliminating desktop clutter, the included stand ensures your battle station remains clean, organized, and display-ready at all times.

 
 Crystal-Clear Flexible Voice Microphone

 Uninterrupted Team Callouts with Integrated Noise-Reduction Filter

 Effective team communication is essential for executing victory strategies. The Lamia 2 comes equipped with an adjustable, flexible omni-directional microphone featuring passive noise-reduction filtering technology. Crisp Audio and Multi-Platform Versatility: Sades MPOWER SA-723 Stereo Wired Gaming Headset - Black/Blue
 Dive into gaming with the Sades MPOWER SA-723 Stereo Wired Gaming Headset - Black/Blue —a budget-friendly, multi-platform headset designed for clear audio and all-day comfort. Its 50mm drivers deliver powerful stereo sound with bass-heavy output, ideal for casual gaming, music, or movies on PS4, Xbox One, Switch, PC, or mobile devices. The retractable omnidirectional microphone ensures clear voice pickup for team chats, while soft PU leather earpads and a lightweight 285g frame keep you comfortable during long sessions. With a 3.5mm jack, inline controls, and a sleek Black/Blue design featuring iron mesh earcups, this headset offers plug-and-play simplicity and stylish durability—perfect for gamers seeking quality and affordability across consoles and handhelds.
 Key Features
 
• 50mm Stereo Drivers: Produce bass-heavy audio with decent clarity—suitable for games like Fortnite or music, though footsteps may be harder to pinpoint compared to premium headsets, as noted in Amazon reviews.

• Retractable Omnidirectional Mic: Captures clear voice for Discord or in-game comms—retracts into the earcup for music or movies, but its flimsy stem struggles to hold shape, per Gadget Explained.

• Multi-Platform Compatibility: 3.5mm jack with L-shaped connector supports PS4, Xbox One (2015), Switch, PC (via Y-splitter), laptops, and mobiles—ideal for handheld gaming, praised by Total Gaming Addicts for plug-and-play ease.

• Lightweight Comfort (285g): Adjustable stainless steel headband and soft PU leather earpads—comfortable for long sessions, though the loose fit may slide on smaller heads, as mentioned in Amazon feedback.

• Inline Volume and Mute Controls: Convenient wheel and mute switch on the 1.2m braided cable—sensitive wheel may adjust accidentally, but it’s handy for quick tweaks, per user reviews.

• Replaceable Earpads: Includes leather and fabric earpads (10g each)—swap for breathability, though swapping is fiddly without magnets, a unique feature for budget headsets noted by Gadget Explained.

• Sleek Black/Blue Design: Iron mesh earcups and blue stainless steel sliders—stylish with subtle Sades branding, though noise cancellation is modest (2.5/5), per Amazon reviews.

 The REDRAGON H888 LUCE is a modern tri-mode gaming headset designed for gamers who want flexibility, lightweight comfort, and immersive sound without dealing with heavy bulky headphones. Its lightweight construction, breathable ear cushions, detachable microphone, and immersive 7.1 surround sound make it an excellent option for competitive gaming, casual gaming, streaming, online meetings, and everyday multimedia use.

 Tri-Mode Connectivity for Maximum Freedom 

 One of the biggest advantages of the REDRAGON H888 LUCE is its flexible connection system. Unlike traditional gaming headsets that only support wired mode, this model offers three different ways to connect.

 2.4GHz Wireless Mode 

 The ultra-low latency 2.4GHz wireless mode delivers stable audio transmission with minimal delay, making it ideal for gaming where timing and sound positioning are critical.

 Bluetooth 5.3 Connectivity

Overview 

 Step into a world of immersive gaming with the Razer Kraken X 7.1 Surround Sound Gaming Headset in sleek black. Designed for gamers who crave powerful audio without compromising comfort or style, the Kraken X delivers stunning 7.1 surround sound, ultra-lightweight construction, and a crystal-clear microphone — all at an unbeatable value. Whether you’re battling enemies, exploring new worlds, or chatting with teammates, this headset enhances every gaming experience with precision and performance.

 
 Immersive 7.1 Surround Sound 

 Precision is everything in competitive gaming, and the Razer Kraken X gives you the edge with 7.1 virtual surround sound . Using custom-tuned 40mm drivers, this headset delivers spatial audio that lets you detect enemy footsteps, gunfire, and environmental cues with pinpoint accuracy. The result is an immersive soundscape that brings your favorite games to life and helps you react faster than ever before. Note: 7.1 surround sound is available on Windows 10 64-bit systems via Razer Synapse software.

 One of the most striking features of the Kraken X is its incredibly light design , weighing just 250 grams . That’s nearly 40% lighter than standard gaming headsets, making it one of the most comfortable headsets in its class. Whether you’re in the middle of a long gaming session, streaming, or chatting with friends, the soft memory foam ear cushions, adjustable headband, and well-balanced clamping force ensure hours of fatigue-free use.

 
 Crystal-Clear Communication 

 Communication is key in multiplayer games, and the bending cardioid microphone on the Razer Kraken X makes sure you’re heard loud and clear. Its unidirectional design focuses solely on your voice, reducing background noise from behind and beside the mic — perfect for team coordination in chaotic game environments. Whether you’re using Discord, TeamSpeak, or in-game chat, your voice will come through with clarity and detail.

compume-18jk3uu.description:
The UGREEN LightBuds Pro (WS215) are premium semi-open True Wireless earbuds engineered for audiophiles, commuters, and professionals who demand adaptive active noise cancellation, Hi-Res Audio via LDAC, Bluetooth 6.0 connectivity, AI-enhanced call quality, and spatial audio — in a comfortable semi-in-ear design that prioritises long-wear comfort alongside serious acoustic performance. Certified CE, FCC, RoHS, and BQB, and backed by a 2-year UGREEN warranty, the LightBuds Pro represent UGREEN's flagship audio product.

 

 SEMI-OPEN DESIGN — COMFORT WITHOUT SEAL FATIGUE

 The LightBuds Pro adopt a semi-open semi-in-ear form factor — positioned at the ear canal entrance without creating a full acoustic seal. This eliminates the pressure and occlusion fatigue associated with deeply-sealed in-ear earbuds during extended listening sessions, while the ANC system compensates for the reduced passive isolation to deliver effective noise cancellation without physical seal dependence. The semi-open design also preserves a degree of ambient awareness for safer use in pedestrian environments.

 

 BLUETOOTH 6.0 — LATEST GENERATION WIRELESS

 The LightBuds Pro are powered by Bluetooth 6.0 — the most recent Bluetooth specification at launch, delivering lower latency, improved connection stability, more efficient power consumption, and enhanced multi-device connectivity over Bluetooth 5.x. The 10-metre operating range maintains stable, uninterrupted wireless connection across typical home, office, and commute distances.

 

 ADAPTIVE ANC 2.0 — UP TO 48dB NOISE REDUCTION

 UGREEN's Adaptive ANC 2.0 uses an AI algorithm to continuously analyse the acoustic environment and dynamically adjust noise cancellation parameters in real time — matching ANC intensity and profile to different noise environments including open offices, public transport, aircraft cabin noise, and street ambient sound. At up to 48dB of noise attenuation, the LightBuds Pro's ANC performance competes with dedicated premium ANC earbuds, isolating the listener from surrounding noise without requiring manual mode switching. ANC modes are fully configurable via the UGREEN App.

 

 LDAC + HI-RES AUDIO — WIRELESS LOSSLESS-QUALITY STREAMING

 The LightBuds Pro support Sony's LDAC high-resolution audio codec — transmitting audio data at up to 990kbps over Bluetooth, approximately three times the data rate of standard SBC and AAC codecs. LDAC enables near-lossless wireless audio streaming from LDAC-compatible sources (Android phones, Sony walkman devices, and LDAC-enabled streaming apps) — delivering studio-quality audio detail, instrument separation, and spatial resolution that standard Bluetooth codecs cannot reproduce. For non-LDAC sources, AAC and SBC provide full backward compatibility.

 

 11MM DYNAMIC DRIVER — RICH BASS, DETAILED HIGHS

 Each earbud is powered by an 11mm dynamic driver — a larger driver diameter than most competing TWS earbuds in this category. The larger 11mm driver moves more air volume per excursion, producing deeper, more impactful bass extension and fuller midrange body alongside clear, detailed high-frequency reproduction — delivering the full-range audio performance that LDAC streaming demands.

 

 SPATIAL AUDIO — IMMERSIVE, DIMENSIONAL SOUNDSTAGE

 The LightBuds Pro support Spatial Audio — processing that simulates three-dimensional sound positioning across music, films, games, and video calls. Spatial Audio creates a wider, more enveloping soundstage than standard stereo reproduction, enhancing the sense of instrument placement, environmental depth, and directional audio in compatible content.

 

 6-MIC AI NOISE CANCELLATION — PROFESSIONAL CALL CLARITY

 Six microphones distributed across both earbuds feed an AI-powered noise cancellation algorithm that isolates voice input from surrounding background noise during calls. The six-microphone array provides redundant directional audio capture — ensuring clear, natural voice transmission in open office

compume-ukmnf1.description:
The UGREEN LightBuds Magic (WS216) is a premium semi-open True Wireless earbuds combining Bluetooth 6.0, Adaptive ANC, LDAC Hi-Res Audio, Spatial Audio, a 6-microphone ENC call system with wind noise reduction, simultaneous dual-device connection, and an LCD full-colour smart screen charging case — in a comfortable semi-open form factor delivering up to 35 hours of total battery life. The WS216 uniquely bridges the LightBuds Pro's semi-open design and the EchoBuds Magic's interactive LCD case into a single product — making it the most feature-complete earbuds in UGREEN's current TWS lineup.

 

 LCD FULL-COLOUR SMART SCREEN CHARGING CASE — INTERACTIVE CONTROL HUB

 The LightBuds Magic's most distinctive feature is its LCD full-colour smart screen on the charging case — a genuine hardware differentiator that transforms the case from a passive battery compartment into an interactive control and personalisation hub:

 - Battery level display: real-time earbud and case charge status at a glance

 - Custom wallpapers: set personal images and visual themes on the case display

 - Song lyrics display: lyrics scroll on the case screen in sync with playback

 - EQ mode selection: switch between sound profiles directly from the case

 - ANC mode control: toggle Adaptive ANC, Transparency, and Normal modes on the case

 - Interface personalisation: change display appearance and visual layout

 All functions are additionally accessible via the UGREEN App for remote configuration.

 

 SEMI-OPEN DESIGN — LONG-WEAR COMFORT WITH ADAPTIVE ANC

 The WS216 adopts a semi-open semi-in-ear design — resting at the ear canal entrance without creating a complete acoustic seal. This eliminates the pressure and occlusion fatigue of fully sealed in-ear earbuds during extended listening sessions, while the Adaptive ANC system compensates for the semi-open design's reduced passive isolation. The result is a genuinely comfortable all-day wearing experience without the pressure buildup that sealed ANC earbuds produce — ideal for extended workday, commute, and study use.

 

 ADAPTIVE ANC — AI ENVIRONMENT ANALYSIS

 Adaptive ANC actively analyses the surrounding acoustic environment in real time and dynamically adjusts noise cancellation intensity and profile to match each setting — from open-plan office background noise and public transport rumble to aircraft cabin pressure and outdoor ambient sound. Unlike fixed-intensity ANC that applies constant cancellation regardless of environment, Adaptive ANC delivers the appropriate cancellation level for each situation — maximising both noise reduction effectiveness and power efficiency simultaneously.

 

 BLUETOOTH 6.0 — LATEST GENERATION, DUAL-DEVICE MULTIPOINT

 Bluetooth 6.0 delivers the most stable, lowest-latency wireless connectivity currently available in TWS earbuds — with improved connection reliability, reduced power consumption, and enhanced multi-device handling over Bluetooth 5.x. Simultaneous dual-device multipoint connection enables seamless switching between two paired devices — a smartphone and laptop, for example — without manual re-pairing. Incoming calls on either device automatically switch audio routing to the active call source.

 

 11MM BIO-COMPOSITE MEMBRANE DRIVER + N52 MAGNET — PREMIUM ACOUSTIC ENGINEERING

 Each earbud houses an 11mm dynamic driver featuring a bio-composite membrane and an N52-grade neodymium magnet — a combination that distinguishes the WS216 from competitors using standard polyurethane or composite diaphragms. The bio-composite membrane combines natural fibre rigidity with polymer flexibility — producing faster transient response, reduced resonance distortion, and more accurate high-frequency reproduction than conventional membrane materials. The N52 magnet (the highest commercially available neodymium magnet grade) provides a stronger magnetic field for greater driver excursion control — delivering deeper, more impactful bass with less distortion at high volume le

compume-1hjea5l.description:
The UGREEN EchoBuds Magic (WS211) are a category-defining pair of True Wireless earbuds that combine 52dB Hybrid Active Noise Cancellation, Hi-Res Audio via LDAC, Bluetooth 5.4, a 6-microphone AI call system, and 30 hours total battery life — with the most distinctive feature in the TWS earbuds segment: a full-colour LCD touchscreen built into the charging case. The EchoBuds Magic transforms the charging case from a passive battery holder into an interactive display for emoji, custom wallpapers, lyrics, playback control, EQ selection, and personalisation — setting it apart from every conventional earbuds case at any price point.

 

 LCD FULL-COLOUR TOUCHSCREEN CHARGING CASE — THE DEFINING DIFFERENTIATOR

 The EchoBuds Magic's charging case features an integrated full-colour LCD touchscreen — a genuine hardware innovation that no other UGREEN earbuds model, and very few TWS products at any price tier, offer. The touchscreen serves as a smart interactive interface for:

 - Custom lock screen wallpapers: personalise the case display with custom images and patterns

 - Animated emoji and emoticon display: expressive visual customisation for gifting, personal style, and social distinction

 - Live lyrics display: song lyrics scroll on the case screen in sync with music playback

 - Music playback control: play, pause, skip, and volume adjustment directly on the case without touching the earbuds

 - EQ mode selection: switch between sound profiles directly on the case display

 - Noise reduction mode switching: toggle ANC, Transparency, and Normal modes from the case

 - Language selection: system language change via case touchscreen

 - Charging status display: real-time battery and charge level visualisation

 

 All touchscreen functions are also accessible via the UGREEN App for remote configuration and deeper customisation.

 

 52dB HYBRID ANC — SUPERIOR NOISE CANCELLATION

 The EchoBuds Magic's Hybrid ANC system combines feedforward and feedback microphone configurations — sampling ambient noise both outside and inside the ear canal simultaneously — to achieve up to 52dB of active noise attenuation. Hybrid ANC outperforms single-configuration (feedforward-only or feedback-only) ANC systems by correcting residual noise that reaches the ear canal after external cancellation, delivering more complete noise isolation across a broader frequency range. At 52dB, the EchoBuds Magic eliminates open-office background chatter, public transport rumble, aircraft cabin noise, and street ambient sound to a degree that matches dedicated premium ANC earbuds.

 

 TRANSPARENCY (AWARENESS) MODE — SAFE AMBIENT MONITORING

 Transparency mode uses the outward-facing microphones to pass ambient sound through to the earbuds in real time — enabling safe environmental awareness for pedestrian navigation, station announcements, colleagues, and conversations without removing the earbuds. Toggle between ANC, Transparency, and Normal modes via the case touchscreen, earbud touch controls, or UGREEN App.

 

 LDAC + HI-RES AUDIO — UP TO 990Kbps WIRELESS STREAMING

 LDAC codec support enables wireless audio streaming at up to 990kbps — approximately 3× the data rate of AAC and SBC — delivering near-lossless audio quality from LDAC-compatible Android devices and music players. The 20Hz–40kHz frequency response extends beyond the standard 20kHz upper limit of human hearing into the ultrasonic range — capturing overtones and harmonic content from Hi-Res Audio recordings that standard 20kHz earbuds cannot reproduce. Sony Hi-Res Audio certified.

 

 10MM DYNAMIC DRIVER — FULL-RANGE AUDIO PERFORMANCE

 Each earbud houses a 10mm dynamic driver delivering rich bass extension, detailed midrange reproduction, and clear high-frequency output across the full 20Hz–40kHz frequency response. The 10mm driver size provides greater acoustic volume displacement than the 6mm and 8mm drivers found in many competing TWS earbuds — producing more impactful bass body and fuller ov

compume-1ocvirv.description:
The ASTRO Gaming A10 Gen 2 Challenger Edition is a special variant of ASTRO's acclaimed A10 Gen 2 wired gaming headset, featuring a distinctive White Challenger colourway designed to complement PlayStation 5 setups. Built on the same proven A10 Gen 2 platform — custom-tuned 32mm dynamic drivers, flip-to-mute boom mic, and ultra-durable construction — the Challenger Edition adds visual distinction for gamers who want performance and style in equal measure.

 

 CUSTOM-TUNED 32MM DYNAMIC DRIVERS

 The A10 Gen 2 Challenger Edition is powered by precision-engineered 32mm dynamic drivers, custom-tuned by ASTRO Audio to reproduce the full 20Hz–20,000Hz frequency spectrum with clarity and balance. Directional audio cues, environmental detail, and team communication all come through with the accuracy that competitive and casual gaming demands.

 

 FLIP-TO-MUTE 6.0MM UNIDIRECTIONAL BOOM MICROPHONE

 The integrated 6.0mm unidirectional boom microphone is optimised to capture your voice clearly while attenuating ambient background noise. A physical flip-to-mute mechanism mutes the microphone instantly when flipped up — and reactivates it the moment it returns to the down position — keeping communication natural and uninterrupted.

 

 DETACHABLE 3.5MM CABLE WITH IN-LINE VOLUME CONTROL

 The A10 Gen 2 Challenger Edition ships with a detachable 3.5mm 5-pole audio cable featuring a built-in in-line volume control wheel. Audio levels can be adjusted mid-game without reaching for a controller or device. The detachable connection also makes cable replacement straightforward, extending the headset's long-term usability.

 

 ULTRA-DURABLE HEADBAND & REPLACEABLE COMPONENTS

 The steel-reinforced flexible headband is engineered to withstand drops, cable tension, and the wear of daily use without cracking or deforming. Ear cushions and the headband pad are fully user-replaceable — removing the need to purchase an entirely new headset as components show wear over time.

 

 CIRCUMAURAL CLOSED-BACK OVER-EAR DESIGN

 The closed-back circumaural ear cups create an acoustic seal around the ear, blocking ambient noise and keeping game audio fully immersive. Padded ear cushions and a cushioned headband pad ensure sustained wearing comfort across extended gaming sessions without pressure fatigue.

 

 UNIVERSAL PLATFORM COMPATIBILITY

 The 3.5mm 5-pole jack connects the A10 Gen 2 Challenger Edition to PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, PC, Mac, Nintendo Switch, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and VR headsets. A PC headphone/microphone splitter cable is included in the box for devices with separate headphone and microphone ports.

 

 CHALLENGER EDITION COLOURWAY

 The White Challenger Edition features exclusive visual design elements that set it apart from the standard A10 Gen 2 White — making it a standout addition to any PS5-themed gaming setup.

• JBL Pure Bass Sound: JBL Pure Bass Sound adds depth, power, and punch to everything you hear. Custom 40mm drivers deliver rich, dynamic audio—whether you’re gearing up for the day, kicking back, or getting lost in the music. 

• Customize your sound with the JBL Headphones App: Make the sound your own with EQ presets. Default for balanced listening, Bass for extra low-end punch, or Vocal to bring voices to the front. Built-in voice prompts confirm your selections, so you always know exactly what mode you’re in. 

• 2 beamforming mics for perfect calls: Two beamforming mics on each earcup precisely capture your speech and reduce background noise. So whether you’re on a teleconference in a busy café or catching up with a friend during your commute, your voice comes through loud and clear. 

• Up to 76 hours of battery life: With up to 76 hours of battery life, your JBL Tune 730BT headphones will outlast your longest playlist. Need a boost? A 5-minute speed charge gives you another 5 hours of playtime. And when it's time for a full recharge, you'll be back to 100% in about two hours.* *Charging cable not included 

• Multi-point connection with Bluetooth 6.0: Pair your headphones with two Bluetooth devices and then switch effortlessly from one to the other. Stream a movie from your tablet in the airport lounge and still hear boarding updates from your phone. Thanks to Bluetooth 6.0 enjoy high-quality streaming with lower power use and reduced latency. So your audio stays perfectly in sync whether you're on a video call or watching a movie. 

• Lightweight, comfortable, and foldable: Stay comfortable no matter how long you listen, thanks to the soft over-ear cups and lightweight padded headband. And when it's time to move on, your JBL Tune 730BT fold flat, so they fit effortlessly into your everyday carry. 

• Fast Pair by Google + Swift Pair by Microsoft: Pairing on Android or Windows 10/11 couldn't be easier. Just power on your JBL Tune 730BT headphones and follow the prompt. No menus, no delays—just seamless listening. 

• Why is there no USB-C charging cable included with my product? To minimize e-waste, we consciously choose not to include a charging cable in our packaging. However, you can use any standard USB-C cable to charge your JBL product.

SteelSeries Arctis Nova 1 Wired Gaming Headset with Retractable Microphone for PC, PlayStation, Xbox, Switch and Mobile 

 Premium Wired Gaming Headset from SteelSeries 

 The SteelSeries Arctis Nova 1 is a premium wired gaming headset made for players who want clear audio, lightweight comfort, and reliable performance across multiple devices. Designed by SteelSeries, this headset is ideal for gaming, voice chat, online calls, and everyday entertainment. With its modern look and trusted gaming design, the Arctis Nova 1 is a strong choice for anyone searching for a high-quality wired gaming headset.

 Lightweight and Comfortable for Long Gaming Sessions 

 Comfort is one of the most important features in any gaming headset, and the SteelSeries Arctis Nova 1 is built to deliver exactly that. Its ultra-slim and lightweight design helps reduce pressure during long gaming sessions, making it suitable for extended play, streaming, study use, and casual listening. Whether you play for one hour or all night, this headset is designed to stay comfortable throughout the day.

 Retractable Microphone for Clear Communication 

 The SteelSeries Arctis Nova 1 comes with a retractable microphone that makes it practical for both gaming and daily use. When you are in a match, on voice chat, or speaking with teammates, the microphone is ready when you need it. When you are done, it can be tucked away neatly into the headset for a cleaner and more stylish look. This makes it a smart option for users who want flexibility and convenience in one headset.

 On-Headset Controls for Fast Access 

 This SteelSeries gaming headset includes on-headset controls that allow quick and easy access while playing. Instead of leaving your game or changing settings from the connected device, you can manage important controls directly from the headset. This improves usability and gives players a smoother gaming experience, especially in fast-paced games where quick adjustments matter.

 Multi-Platform Compatibility for Everyday Gaming 

 One of the biggest advantages of the SteelSeries Arctis Nova 1 is its wide compatibility. It is designed to work with PC, PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, and mobile devices, making it an excellent multi-platform gaming headset. If you use more than one system, this headset gives you the flexibility to enjoy the same sound and comfort across all your devices without needing separate headsets.

 Reliable Wired Connection with Stable Performance 

 A wired gaming headset remains one of the best choices for users who want a stable and direct connection. The SteelSeries Arctis Nova 1 gives you dependable performance without worrying about charging, battery life, or wireless connection issues. Just plug it in and start gaming. This makes it a practical solution for gamers who want simple, fast, and reliable use every time.

 Modern Design That Looks Great on Any Setup 

 The SteelSeries Arctis Nova 1 features a sleek black design that gives it a clean and premium appearance. It looks great on gaming desks, console setups, and workstations, making it suitable not only for gaming but also for general daily use. Its balanced design helps it appeal to both serious gamers and casual users looking for a stylish wired headset from a trusted brand.

 Perfect for Gaming, Chat, Entertainment and Daily Use 

 This headset is not only built for gaming, but also for communication, media, and general desktop use. It is a practical option for students, gamers, content viewers, and anyone who wants a versatile headset with strong everyday usability. If you are looking for a SteelSeries wired gaming headset with retractable mic, lightweight comfort, and multi-platform support, the Arctis Nova 1 is a smart and dependable choice.

Soundcore Liberty Buds Wireless Semi-In-Ear Earbuds with ANC — White 
 Discover a new dimension of audio freedom with the Soundcore Liberty Buds, a sophisticated pair of semi-in-ear wireless earbuds engineered to deliver premium sound quality, intelligent noise cancellation, and all-day wearing comfort in one elegantly crafted package. Presented in a clean, minimalist white finish, the Liberty Buds are as refined in appearance as they are exceptional in performance, making them an ideal choice for discerning listeners who value both style and substance.
 The semi-in-ear design sets the Liberty Buds apart from conventional in-ear earbuds, offering a lighter, more breathable fit that rests comfortably in the ear without the pressure or fatigue associated with deep-insertion tips. This open, ergonomic form factor makes them exceptionally well-suited for extended listening sessions, whether during a full workday, a long commute, or a leisurely afternoon of music and relaxation.
 Equipped with Advanced Active Noise Cancellation, the Liberty Buds intelligently identify and suppress environmental noise, creating a personal acoustic sanctuary wherever you are. The accompanying transparency mode seamlessly blends ambient sound back into your listening environment with a single tap, ensuring you remain aware of important sounds around you without fully removing your earbuds.
 Driven by high-performance acoustic drivers, the Liberty Buds produce a beautifully balanced soundstage with sparkling highs, articulate mids, and warm, natural bass. Every genre of music, every podcast, and every call is rendered with outstanding clarity and depth, reflecting Soundcore's commitment to Hi-Fi grade audio quality across all price points.
 Multi-point Bluetooth connectivity allows the Liberty Buds to stay simultaneously paired with two devices, enabling effortless switching between your smartphone and laptop without the need to manually disconnect and reconnect.  Discover a new dimension of audio freedom with the Soundcore Liberty Buds, a sophisticated pair of semi-in-ear wireless earbuds engineered to deliver premium sound quality, intelligent noise cancellation, and all-day wearing comfort in one elegantly crafted package. Presented in a vibrant, contemporary blue finish, the Liberty Buds make a confident style statement while delivering the same exceptional acoustic performance that defines the Liberty Buds lineup, making them an ideal choice for listeners who want their earbuds to reflect their personality as much as their passion for great sound.

 The semi-in-ear design sets the Liberty Buds apart from conventional in-ear earbuds, offering a lighter, more breathable fit that rests comfortably in the ear without the pressure or fatigue associated with deep-insertion tips. This open, ergonomic form factor makes them exceptionally well-suited for extended listening sessions, whether during a full workday, a long commute, or a leisurely afternoon of music and relaxation.

 Equipped with Advanced Active Noise Cancellation, the Liberty Buds intelligently identify and suppress environmental noise, creating a personal acoustic sanctuary wherever you are. The accompanying transparency mode seamlessly blends ambient sound back into your listening environment with a single tap, ensuring you remain aware of important sounds around you without fully removing your earbuds.

 Driven by high-performance acoustic drivers, the Liberty Buds produce a beautifully balanced soundstage with sparkling highs, articulate mids, and warm, natural bass. Every genre of music, every podcast, and every call is rendered with outstanding clarity and depth, reflecting Soundcore's commitment to Hi-Fi grade audio quality across all price points.

 Multi-point Bluetooth connectivity allows the Liberty Buds to stay simultaneously paired with two devices, enabling effortless switching between your smartphone and laptop without the need to manually disconnect and reconnect. Touch controls on each earbud provide intuitive management of all key functions, while the Soundcore app unlocks a full suite of customization options including EQ settings, ANC intensity adjustment, and personalized touch control mapping.

compume-1uldika.description:
Soundcore AeroFit 2 Open-Ear Wireless Earbuds — White 
 Experience the next evolution in open-ear audio with the Soundcore AeroFit 2, a premium wireless earbud designed for active individuals who demand exceptional sound quality, a secure athletic fit, and the freedom of natural ambient awareness during every activity. Presented in a crisp, sporty white finish, the AeroFit 2 combines advanced acoustic engineering with an innovative open-ear form factor that redefines what truly comfortable, high-performance wireless audio feels like.
 The AeroFit 2 features a refined open-ear hook design that wraps securely around the outer ear without inserting into the ear canal, delivering a liberating, pressure-free listening experience that remains stable and comfortable through the most demanding physical activities. Whether you are running, cycling, training at the gym, or navigating a busy urban environment, the AeroFit 2 stays firmly in place without ever causing the discomfort or fatigue associated with traditional in-ear designs.
 Powered by large-aperture dynamic drivers, the AeroFit 2 produces an impressively rich and spacious soundstage that defies the expectations of open-ear audio. Deep, powerful bass, clear and natural mids, and detailed highs come together to create an immersive listening experience that rivals conventional sealed earbuds, all while keeping you naturally connected to the sounds of your environment for enhanced safety and situational awareness during outdoor activities.
 Engineered for an active lifestyle, the AeroFit 2 carries an IPX5 water resistance rating that provides reliable protection against sweat, splashes, and light rain, ensuring consistent performance no matter how intense your session gets. The ergonomic earhook design is available in multiple size configurations to accommodate a wide range of ear shapes, guaranteeing a personalized, secure fit for every user.
 Bluetooth 5.3 connectivity delivers a stable, low-latency wireless connection with an extended range, while multi-point pairing allows simultaneous connection to two devices for seamless switching between your phone and laptop. The Soundcore app provides access to EQ customization, control personalization, and firmware updates, putting full command of your audio experience in your hands.
 The accompanying charging case offers convenient, portable battery replenishment, extending total playtime to keep you powered through full training days, long commutes, and everything in between.
 A benchmark open-ear audio experience for active, health-conscious listeners who refuse to choose between exceptional sound and complete environmental awareness.

Alienware AW725H Tri-Mode Wireless Gaming Headset – Dark Side of the Moon

 Premium Wireless Gaming Performance

 The Alienware AW725H Tri-Mode Wireless Gaming Headset in Dark Side of the Moon is built for gamers who want premium sound, powerful wireless flexibility, and a modern design that matches high-end gaming setups. This headset is made for serious daily use, whether you are playing competitive games, enjoying story-driven adventures, chatting with friends, or listening to music between sessions. With its premium construction, advanced features, and iconic Alienware styling, the AW725H is designed to deliver a complete gaming audio experience.

 Tri-Mode Connectivity for Maximum Flexibility

 One of the biggest strengths of the Alienware AW725H is its tri-mode connectivity. It gives users multiple ways to connect depending on the device and the situation. You can use low-latency 2.4GHz wireless for responsive gaming, Bluetooth for mobile devices and casual everyday use, or a 3.5mm wired connection when you prefer a direct setup.

 This flexibility makes the headset ideal for gamers who switch between different platforms. It works well for desktop gaming, console gaming, mobile entertainment, and general multimedia use. Instead of buying separate headsets for different devices, the AW725H gives you one premium solution that can handle everything with ease.

 Immersive Sound That Brings Games to Life

 Sound quality is one of the most important parts of any gaming headset, and the Alienware AW725H is built to impress. It features powerful drivers that help produce rich, clear, and detailed audio across different types of content. Whether you are hearing footsteps in a competitive match, explosions in an action game, or voices in a cinematic cutscene, the headset is made to deliver a more immersive experience.

 The wide sound range helps create strong bass, balanced mids, and crisp highs, giving your games, movies, and music a more refined and premium feel. This makes the headset suitable not only for gaming but also for entertainment in general.

 Dolby Atmos for Better Positional Audio

 The Alienware AW725H supports Dolby Atmos, which adds another level of depth and realism to your listening experience. With more accurate positional sound, players can better detect where sounds are coming from during gameplay. This is especially useful in competitive games where awareness and reaction time matter.

 Dolby Atmos helps create a more spacious soundstage, allowing in-game effects to feel more natural and more precisely placed around you. Instead of flat audio, the headset delivers a more layered and realistic presentation that makes gaming more engaging and enjoyable.

 Clear Voice Communication with Retractable Microphone

 A good gaming headset needs a strong microphone, and the AW725H delivers exactly that. It includes a retractable boom microphone designed for clear communication during multiplayer games, voice chats, and online meetings. The microphone helps your voice sound cleaner and more focused, making it easier for teammates and friends to hear you.

 The retractable design is also a practical advantage. When you do not need the microphone, you can simply tuck it away to keep the headset looking clean and streamlined. This makes the AW725H a good choice not just for gaming, but also for general everyday use.

 Long Battery Life for Extended Sessions

 Battery life is one of the standout features of the Alienware AW725H. It is designed for users who spend long hours gaming or listening without wanting to recharge constantly. With extended battery performance, the headset can handle long gaming sessions, work calls, entertainment, and daily use more comfortably.

 More Features
 Waterproof and dustproof: The JBL Endurance Race 2 is made for your toughest workout. Their IP68 rating means they're fully dustproof and waterproof, with complete protection against solid particles and the ability to survive being submerged deeper than a meter in both fresh water and sea water. Even the charging case is IPX2 water-resistant, so it can come along on your next rainy-day run.
 Ergonomic wing enhancer with Twist lock technology: The ergonomic wing enhancer on the JBL Endurance Race 2 earbuds uses Twist lock™ technology. That means a better seal and with more stability in your ears when you're using them, not to mention all-day comfort.
 Enhance your work-out with 'Sports Mode: Use the JBL Headphones app to match your workout with ANC, Ambient Aware and EQ. Adjust the settings to the intensity of your workout, choosing one of the six default Sports Modes - or you can customize your own. And when your workout is over, chill out and recharge in Relax Mode by choosing one of five peaceful sounds, like gentle ocean waves or a crackling wood fire.
 
 Active Noise Cancelling with Smart Ambient: JBL Endurance Race 2 earbuds use Active Noise Cancelling to listen to your surroundings and filter out distracting noise. Smart Ambient lets you control how much of the outside world you want to hear, so you can talk with others or stay aware of your surroundings—all without taking your earbuds out.
 4 mics for crisp, clear calls: Two beamforming mics on each earbud pick up and transmit your voice while cancelling out ambient noise. So, you can make clear, crisp calls even when you're jogging through a busy park on a breezy day.
 JBL Pure Bass sound: JBL Endurance Race 2 earbuds feature 6.8mm dynamic drivers that deliver powerful JBL Pure Bass sound.
 48 hours of playback time, plus speed charging : Enjoy 12 hours of playtime, plus another three full charges (36 hours) in the charging case. Need to recharge even faster? 10 minutes on a USB type-C charging cable will give you another four hours of playtime
 Multi-point connection: Pair your JBL Endurance Race 2 earbuds with two Bluetooth® devices and then switch effortlessly from one to the other. So, if you're watching a video on your tablet, you won't miss a call on your mobile phone.
 Seamless Bluetooth pairing: JBL Endurance Race 2 come enabled with both Fast Pair by Google and Swift Pair by Microsoft, so you can pair both your Android devices and Microsoft computer with a single tap.

HyperX Cloud III S Wireless

 HyperX Cloud III S Wireless Gaming Headset ( Red ) [ A59Z0AA ] 

 The Cloud III S Wireless represents the next evolution of Cloud III Wireless, retaining all the beloved features of its predecessor. In addition to the 2.4GHz wireless connectivity, users can connect to more devices via Bluetooth or an Instant Pair mode that is compatible with select OMEN laptops.

 It also boasts extended battery life and multiple customization options. With HyperX signature comfort, this headset delivers luxurious comfort for all-day gaming or marathon streaming sessions.

 With up to 120 hours of battery life, you can enjoy hours of uninterrupted gaming fun via 2.4GHz. Push the limits even further with up to 200 hours in Bluetooth mode.

 Equipped with 53mm angled drivers and a lifetime activation of DTS® Headphone:X® Spatial Audio, it delivers crystal-clear sound and enhanced audio positioning, precisely identifying critical audio cues like footsteps.

 The 10mm microphone provides clear communication with teammates, crisp call quality, and effortless conversations with friends. With easy-to-use audio controls, you can swiftly mute or unmute the microphone, adjust volume levels, and switch between wireless modes effortlessly.

 Whether you’re gaming, listening to music, watching YouTube, browsing Twitch, or completing assignments, the Cloud III S Wireless ensures you never miss a beat or crucial shot!

 Key Features of HyperX Cloud III S Wireless 

 Up to 120 Hours1 of Gaming on a Single Charge 

 Achieve up to 120 hours of gameplay on 2.4GHz. Push the limits even further with up to 200 hours in Bluetooth Mode.

 

 Connect via 2.4GHz, Bluetooth or Instant Pairing 

 Gain the convenience and versatility of wireless freedom with 2.4GHz wireless or Bluetooth connectivity. Instant Pair is also available with select OMEN gaming laptops, no dongle required.

 

 Audio Tuned for Your Entertainment 

 Angled 53mm drivers have been tuned by HyperX audio engineers to provide an optimized listening experience that accents the dynamic sounds of gaming.

 

 HyperX Signature Comfort 

 Comfort is in the Cloud III’s DNA. HyperX signature memory foam in the headband and ear cushions wrapped in soft, premium leatherette make for a plush, comfortable fit all around.

 

 Ultra-Clear and Convenient Communication 

 The versatile detachable 10mm boom mic features an LED mic mute indicator and built-in mesh filter to capture high-quality audio for clear voice chat and calls. Use the boom mic in both 2.4GHz or Bluetooth modes for optimal mic performance or go boomless for convenience.

 

 DTS® Headphone:X® Spatial Audio 

 A lifetime activation of DTS® Spatial Audio will help amp up your audio advantage and immersion on PC with its precise sound localization and virtual 3D sound stage.

 

 Durable Gaming Headset, for the Toughest of Battles 

 The headset is flexible and features an aluminum frame so it’s resilient against travel, accidents, mishaps, and routine wear and tear.

 

 Convenient Wireless and Media Controls 

 Take command of your audio experience with intuitive controls including a wireless mode selector, volume wheel, mute button and multi-function button for convenient media playback and call management.

 

 Multi-device support via USB-C, USB-A & Bluetooth Gaming Headset 

 Cloud III S Wireless is compatible with PC, PS5, PS4, Nintendo Switch, Mac, Mobile, and Bluetooth devices5. USB-A and USB-C connectors are included for maximum compatibility, no matter how you game.

 

 Removable Earcup Plates to Match Your Setup 

 Personalize your headset with removable magnetic earcup plates to match your unique setups. Sold separately and available in select countries/regions.

compume-1sfp9yq.description:
LEGENDARY GEAR. LEGENDARY PLAY.

 G522 LIGHTSPEED is designed for extensive play and unrivaled performance—as part of the legendary G5 Series. With dynamic LIGHTSYNC RGB lighting, immersive sound, and the best microphone in gaming, G522 makes every play, achievement, and breakthrough in your game feel truly legendary.

 

 
 
 

 
 SYNCHRONIZED PRO-G AUDIO DRIVERS

 Whether you’re sneaking past guards, unlocking legendary loot, or just vibing out in an RPG, every sound matters. Capture the full soundscape of your game with low-profile synchronized audio.

 
 

 
 SPATIAL ACCURACY

 Logitech G522 LIGHTSPEED features spatial audio that allows you to pinpoint the location of in-game audio cues, from gunfire and footsteps to lurking enemies and hidden loot. Gain a competitive advantage in ranked play or become more immersed in your favorite single-player games with precise directional audio.

 
 

 
 AUDIO LAYERS

 When listening to game audio, many different sound layers play at the same time, like music, sound effects, dialog, voice chat, and more. PRO-G drivers are built to reproduce audio from multiple sound layers simultaneously so you hear each sound layer as clearly as possible and enjoy a soundtrack while you game.

 
 
 Additional Features

 

 
 

 
 

 
 BETTER BASS
 Sound waves bounce off any surface they come in contact with and with each bounce the sound changes. Our acoustic modules are completely isolated from other components, which gives us more control to increase the bass output for a richer audio experience.

 

 
 BEST-IN-CLASS MICROPHONE
 Your game does the talking for you. But when you need to rally the squad or announce your latest legendary move, make every word crystal clear with best in class full bandwidth 48 kHz voice clarity and BLUE VO!CE tech.

 

 
 BROADCAST QUALITY MIC
 48 kHz is the highest bandwidth mic you can get in a gaming headset and is only matched by the likes of the ASTRO A50 and A50 X. More bandwidth means more data and more data means more clarity, so you always come through loud and clear on comms. The only downside is always being asked “wait, what mic are you using?”

 

 
 BLUE VO!CE CUSTOMIZATION
 BLUE VO!CE gives you deep voice customization and tuning options from Input Gain, to Mic EQ, and SIGNAL CLEANUP, so you can tailor your sound exactly the way you want to. When you find your winning combo, use the SAMPLER TOOL to hear how it all came together.

 

 
 REMOVABLE MIC WITH MUTE LED
 The 48 kHz boom mic is fully removable. When you don’t need your mic, you can easily pop it out to pack your headset or take a quick snack or drink break. The red LED on the tip of the mic lets you know when you’re muted, so you don’t have to worry about distracting your squad.

 

 
 LIGHTWEIGHT COMFORT
 Seriously comfortable design with dual-layers of memory foam to cushion and cool, softer and more durable fabrics, a larger and more natural ear cup shape, and a suspension band with ridges for better airflow, all at a comfortably light 290g.

 

 
 LIGHTSPEED TRI-MODE CONNECTIVITY
 Connect in 3 different ways with pro-grade LIGHTSPEED wireless via G522’s included LIGHTSPEED dongle, Bluetooth wireless for even more connection options, and USB-C wired with audio and data passthrough.

 

 
 DYNAMIC LIGHTSYNC RGB
 G522 LIGHTSPEED’s unmistakable, recessed, LIGHTSYNC RGB has 8 total customizable lighting zones and 16.8 million colors to choose from. Try out different lighting effects and patterns to personalize your look for any game, outfit, gaming setup, or vibe.

 

 
 CUSTOMIZATION SOFTWARE
 G HUB and G MOBILE bring out the best in your Logitech G gear. Download on Windows, macOS, or mobile to update your gear, adjust settings, synchronize lights, and personalize until it's truly yours.

 Hear What Others Are Saying...

igeek-1hjrj68.description:
LEGENDARY GEAR. LEGENDARY PLAY.

 G522 LIGHTSPEED is designed for extensive play and unrivaled performance—as part of the legendary G5 Series. With dynamic LIGHTSYNC RGB lighting, immersive sound, and the best microphone in gaming, G522 makes every play, achievement, and breakthrough in your game feel truly legendary.

 

 
 
 
 

 
 SYNCHRONIZED PRO-G AUDIO DRIVERS

 Whether you’re sneaking past guards, unlocking legendary loot, or just vibing out in an RPG, every sound matters. Capture the full soundscape of your game with low-profile synchronized audio.

 
 

 
 SPATIAL ACCURACY

 Logitech G522 LIGHTSPEED features spatial audio that allows you to pinpoint the location of in-game audio cues, from gunfire and footsteps to lurking enemies and hidden loot. Gain a competitive advantage in ranked play or become more immersed in your favorite single-player games with precise directional audio.

 
 

 
 AUDIO LAYERS

 When listening to game audio, many different sound layers play at the same time, like music, sound effects, dialog, voice chat, and more. PRO-G drivers are built to reproduce audio from multiple sound layers simultaneously so you hear each sound layer as clearly as possible and enjoy a soundtrack while you game.

 
 
 Additional Features

 

 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 BETTER BASS

 
 
 Sound waves bounce off any surface they come in contact with and with each bounce the sound changes. Our acoustic modules are completely isolated from other components, which gives us more control to increase the bass output for a richer audio experience.

 
 
 

 
 
 
 BEST-IN-CLASS MICROPHONE

 
 
 Your game does the talking for you. But when you need to rally the squad or announce your latest legendary move, make every word crystal clear with best in class full bandwidth 48 kHz voice clarity and BLUE VO!CE tech.

 
 
 

 
 
 
 BROADCAST QUALITY MIC

 
 
 48 kHz is the highest bandwidth mic you can get in a gaming headset and is only matched by the likes of the ASTRO A50 and A50 X. More bandwidth means more data and more data means more clarity, so you always come through loud and clear on comms. The only downside is always being asked “wait, what mic are you using?”

 
 
 

 
 
 
 BLUE VO!CE CUSTOMIZATION

 
 
 BLUE VO!CE gives you deep voice customization and tuning options from Input Gain, to Mic EQ, and SIGNAL CLEANUP, so you can tailor your sound exactly the way you want to. When you find your winning combo, use the SAMPLER TOOL to hear how it all came together.

 
 
 

 
 
 
 REMOVABLE MIC WITH MUTE LED

 
 
 The 48 kHz boom mic is fully removable. When you don’t need your mic, you can easily pop it out to pack your headset or take a quick snack or drink break. The red LED on the tip of the mic lets you know when you’re muted, so you don’t have to worry about distracting your squad.

 
 
 

 
 
 
 LIGHTWEIGHT COMFORT

 
 
 Seriously comfortable design with dual-layers of memory foam to cushion and cool, softer and more durable fabrics, a larger and more natural ear cup shape, and a suspension band with ridges for better airflow, all at a comfortably light 290g.

 
 
 

 
 
 
 LIGHTSPEED TRI-MODE CONNECTIVITY

 
 
 Connect in 3 different ways with pro-grade LIGHTSPEED wireless via G522’s included LIGHTSPEED dongle, Bluetooth wireless for even more connection options, and USB-C wired with audio and data passthrough.

 
 
 

 
 
 
 DYNAMIC LIGHTSYNC RGB

 
 
 G522 LIGHTSPEED’s unmistakable, recessed, LIGHTSYNC RGB has 8 total customizable lighting zones and 16.8 million colors to choose from. Try out different lighting effects and patterns to personalize your look for any game, outfit, gaming setup, or vibe.

 
 
 

 
 
 
 CUSTOMIZATION SOFTWARE

 
 
 G HUB and G MOBILE bring out the best in your Logitech G gear. Download on Windows, macOS, or mobile to update your gear, adjust settings, synchronize lights, and personalize until it's truly yours.

Compact and Reliable Audio with the JBL Live 770NC Wireless Headset - White / Blue

 Elevate your audio game with the JBL Live 770NC Wireless Headset in White / Blue—a striking over-ear headset that fuses JBL Signature Sound with cutting-edge True Adaptive Noise Cancelling. Featuring Bluetooth 5.3 multipoint connectivity, 40mm drivers with immersive Spatial Sound, and up to 65 hours of battery life, this headset is tailored for music lovers, remote professionals, and anyone craving distraction-free listening. Its foldable, lightweight design (219g) and dual noise-canceling mics ensure comfort and clarity for all-day wear and calls, while the JBL Headphones app unlocks EQ customization and voice assistant access. Dressed in a bold Blue finish with subtle White accents, the Live 770NC delivers standout style and performance—your perfect companion for work, play, and everything in between.

compume-1wszfod.description:
A new iconic metal design, engineered for all-day comfort and unparalleled sound. Feel the difference with these all-new, beautifully designed earbuds that fit your ears perfectly. 
 
 Innovative Design: 
 The new shape has been meticulously crafted. This optimized design ensures superior sound quality, reduces pressure on the ear canal, and stays securely in your ears, whether you're indoors or outdoors, making them ideal for everyday wear and all-day comfort. 
 
 Seamless Control: 
 Leave your phone in your pocket and easily control your earbuds with simple touch gestures. Just nod and shake your head. Nodding and shaking allow you to respond quickly, from answering calls to talking to Bixby, without lifting your hand. Get what you want easily, even when your hands are full or it's not a good time to talk. 
 
 Enhanced Sound Quality: 
 Enjoy the balanced sound of the Galaxy Buds4, powered by an 11mm wide-range driver that delivers rich, clear audio from deep bass to crisp highs, tailoring the sound to your mood. Take a closer look at the sound we use in our everyday lives. Adjust the bass, treble, and pitch with the 9-band equalizer to match your preferred sound, creating a sound tailored specifically for you. 
 The Galaxy Buds4 optimizes sound levels to suit the shape of your ear and how you wear it, ensuring a harmonious listening experience even when the volume is adjusted. 
 
 High-Definition Sound: 
 Enjoy crystal-clear communication, even in noisy environments. Your voice is captured clearly by 6 microphones surrounding your head, intelligently isolating it from background noise with advanced Deep Neural Network ( DNN ) technology. The pure audio signal is transmitted seamlessly via Super Wideband (SWB) with quality up to 16kHz between your Galaxy Buds4 and your Galaxy phone. Hear and be heard clearly – even in noisy environments. 
 
 Audio 360 technology: 
 Expand your sound from stereo to an orchestra pit or a grand concert hall, and experience the atmosphere of a live performance with a single touch. Enjoy the beauty of sounds and instruments in a three-dimensional field that precisely determines the direction of sound when you tilt your head, and immerse yourself in the music around you when paired with compatible Samsung devices. 
 
 Active Noise Cancellation (ANC): 
 With its high-quality sound system, the Galaxy Buds 4 precisely control noise, minimizing distractions with active noise cancellation algorithms that process distortion and adapt to the shape of your ear. Experience enchanting sound wherever you are, and control your listening experience with the Galaxy Buds 4, which adjusts ANC levels and ambient sounds in real time, adapting to your environment, whether you're sensitive to noise or prefer a mix of sounds. Immerse yourself in music and connect with the world simultaneously. 
 
 Instant Translation: 
 With Samsung AI, understanding the world has never been easier. See the translation on your Samsung smartphone and listen to the conversation explained in real time with Galaxy Buds 4. The Translator feature starts with the last user, giving you the freedom to communicate seamlessly across languages when paired with a compatible Samsung phone. 
 
 AI Assistant: 
 Ask for help with your voice—without having to reach for your phone. Simply speak to an AI assistant like Bixby, and it will answer your questions or manage your tasks without interrupting your activity.
