compume-15srgab.description: The Logitech G ASTRO A20 X is a multi-platform wireless gaming headset built for players who switch between consoles, PC and mobile devices. Its PLAYSYNC AUDIO system connects to two gaming systems and allows quick switching between them, while LIGHTSPEED wireless, Bluetooth 5.3 and USB wired connectivity provide flexible ways to play. Key Features PLAYSYNC AUDIO: Conne two gaming systems and switch between them with the PLAYSYNC control. 40 mm PRO-G Drivers: Tri-Mode Connectivity: LIGHTSPEED wireless, Bluetooth 5.3 and USB wired connection options. LIGHTSYNC RGB: Eight customizable lighting zones with up to 16.8 million colors. Long Battery Life: Up to 90 hours with lighting off or up to 40 hours using the default lighting settings. Technical Specifications Component Specification Logitech G Series ASTRO Series Model ASTRO A20 X Part Number Produ Type Wireless Gaming Headset Color White 40 mm Biocellulose PRO-G 20 Hz–20 kHz Omnidirectional 70 Hz–20 kHz 48 kHz Full Bandwidth Connectivity LIGHTSPEED Wireless via USB, Bluetooth 5.3, USB Wired Wireless Range Up to 30 m PLAYSYNC AUDIO 2-System Switching LIGHTSPEED Audio Up to 24-bit / 48 kHz on PC; Up to 16-bit / 48 kHz on Console RGB Lighting LIGHTSYNC RGB, 8 Customizable Zones, 16.8 Million Colors Battery Type Rechargeable Battery Life - Lighting Off Up to 90 Hours Battery Life - Default Lighting Up to 40 Hours Weight 290 g Comfort Memory Foam, Suspension Headband Software Logitech G HUB, Logitech G Mobile App Compatibility & Important Information LIGHTSPEED Compatibility: Xbox, PS5, PC and Nintendo Switch / Switch 2 are supported with the required USB connection. Nintendo Switch / Switch 2: Logitech states that a firmware update through G HUB on Windows or macOS is required. Computer Requirements: Windows or macOS systems require an available USB 2.0 port for LIGHTSPEED connectivity. Bluetooth: Bluetooth audio requires a device supporting Bluetooth 5.3 audio connectivity. PLAYSYNC AUDIO: Allows two compatible gaming systems to remain connected for quick switching between them. Software: Internet access is required for Logitech G HUB and the Logitech G Mobile App. Package Contents 1 × Logitech G ASTRO A20 X LIGHTSPEED Wireless Gaming Headset 1 × PLAYSYNC BASE 2 × 1.8 m USB-C to USB-A Cables User Documentation Please to review Q: Is part number the White ASTRO A20 X? A: Yes. Logitech identifies as the White version of the ASTRO A20 X. Q: Which gaming systems work with the ASTRO A20 X? A: Logitech lists LIGHTSPEED compatibility with Xbox, PS5, PC and Nintendo Switch / Switch 2. Nintendo Switch / Switch 2 requires a firmware update through G HUB on Windows or macOS. Q: What does PLAYSYNC AUDIO do? A: PLAYSYNC AUDIO allows two compatible gaming systems to remain connected so you can switch between them using the PLAYSYNC button. Q: Does the ASTRO A20 X support Bluetooth? A: Yes. It supports Bluetooth 5.3 audio connectivity in addition to LIGHTSPEED wireless and USB wired operation. Q: How long does the battery last? A: Logitech specifies up to 90 hours with lighting disabled and up to 40 hours using the default LIGHTSYNC RGB settings. Q: Does the headset have RGB lighting? A: Yes. LIGHTSYNC RGB provides eight customizable lighting zones and up to 16.8 million colors. Q: What comes in the box?

igeek-1mzgyc7.description:
Compact and Reliable Performance with the Razer Barracuda Wireless & Bluetooth Multi-Platform Gaming Headset - White

 Conquer any gaming setup or mobile adventure with the Razer Barracuda Wireless & Bluetooth Multi-Platform Gaming Headset - White —a hybrid headset designed for seamless audio across platforms. Its 50mm TriForce drivers deliver rich, layered sound, enhanced by THX Spatial Audio for immersive 3D positioning, perfect for pinpointing enemies or enjoying movies. Dual beamforming noise-cancelling mics ensure clear voice pickup for team chats or calls, while SmartSwitch dual-wireless (HyperSpeed 2.4GHz and Bluetooth 5.2) toggles effortlessly between gaming and mobile modes. At 300g with plush FlowKnit earpads, it offers all-day comfort, and its 40-hour battery life keeps you powered for days. In a sleek Mercury White finish, this headset blends bold style with versatile performance—ideal for gamers who play everywhere and want to stand out.

 
 Key Features

 
• 
 50mm TriForce Drivers: Splits audio into highs, mids, and lows for crisp, balanced sound—THX Spatial Audio creates a wide, directional soundstage for competitive gaming or cinematic music playback.

• 
 Dual Beamforming Noise-Cancelling Mics: Integrated mics capture clear vocals with minimal background noise—great for Discord calls or streaming, though less robust in loud environments than boom mics.

• 
 SmartSwitch Dual Wireless: Connects to 2.4GHz for lag-free gaming and Bluetooth 5.2 for mobile—double-tap to switch modes, with auto-switching for calls and ‘Do Not Disturb’ via Razer Audio App.

• 
 40-Hour Battery Life: USB-C charging delivers up to 40 hours (tested at ~60 hours at moderate volume)—supports wired 3.5mm use when powered off, ensuring uninterrupted audio for travel or play.

• 
 Lightweight Comfort Design: 300g frame with breathable FlowKnit memory foam and leatherette earpads—swiveling cups and a padded headband stay comfy for hours, with passive isolation for noisy settings.

• 
 Multi-Platform Versatility: Works with PC, PS5, Switch, and mobile via USB-C dongle, Bluetooth, or 3.5mm cable—low-latency 2.4GHz excels for gaming, while Bluetooth suits casual smartphone use.

• 
 Mercury White Aesthetic: Glossy White earcups with Black accents (sliders, padding)—adds a clean, modern vibe to light-themed desks, doubling as stylish headphones for public outings.

JBL TOUR PRO 2

 The JBL Tour Pro 2's True Adaptive Noise Cancelling technology tunes out distractions so you can enjoy your favorite audio—or even the sound of silence—all powered by legendary JBL Pro Sound and experience seamless, superb sound on the go. The unique smart charging case allows you to control the earbuds' settings without using your phone or the App. Immerse yourself in spatial audio for up to 40 hours on a single charge.

 

 
 
 

 
 JBL TOUR PRO 2

 Smart Case for seamless experience

 Control the earbuds' settings, manage calls and playback, control your audio setting and battery level and set your alarm through the screen of the charging case. Enjoy a truly seamless experience with JBL Tour Pro 2's unique smart charging case without using your phone or the JBL Headphones App.

 

 
 
 

 
 JBL TOUR PRO 2

 True Adaptive Noise Cancelling with Smart Ambient

 True Adaptive Noise Cancelling technology automatically uses 4 noise sensing mics to adjust to your surroundings in real-time, minimizing distractions and optimizing the JBL Tour Pro 2's performance for a superior audio experience—all while you adjust ANC mode control with the JBL Headphones app.

 

 
 
 JBL TOUR PRO 2

 6-mic perfect calls with voice control

 The 6-mic crystal call algorithm of the JBL Tour Pro 2 earbuds allows you to have better conversations even in loud or windy environments or to get help from your preferred voice assistant. And with VoiceAware, you can choose how much of your own voice to hear by controlling the amount of mic input routed back into your earbuds.

 INZONE H9 Wireless Noise Canceling Gaming Headset

 

 
 
 
 
 

 
 Experience 360 Spatial Sound for gaming

 
 Discover 360 Spatial Sound, activated by the INZONE Hub. It’s PC software with an all-new virtualizer to reproduce an immersive 7.1ch surround sound experience. With 360 Spatial Sound combined with our hardware technology, you can pinpoint your opponent’s location wherever they’re hiding.

 
 

 
 Just the game, no other sounds

 
 Experience the same Dual Sensor Noise Canceling Technology we developed for our class-leading 1000X series headphones. The INZONE H9 uses this multiple-microphone noise-canceling tech to keep out the sounds that keep you from performing your best . 

 
 
 
 
 

 
 Power through a whole day of missions

 
 Marathon gaming is no match for this kind of power. Get up to 32 hours of continuous play (with Noise Canceling OFF) from a single charge. In case of emergency, get up to an hour of game time for a quick 10-minute mini-charge. Play while charging—a long USB cable keeps you in the game.

 
 

 
 Be immersed and still be aware

 
 With Ambient Sound Mode, you can play your game and still hear important sounds like phone calls, doorbells, or someone speaking to you in your environment. And just like with Sony music headphones, it’s just a touch of a button to switch to noise-canceling mode.

compume-10oo0f6.description:
Designed With Xbox

 When it came time to create our first-ever limited edition Meta Quest, we knew it had to be iconic—and the results speak for themselves.

 

 We worked in close partnership with Xbox to create a limited edition Quest that reflects the unmistakable Xbox colors. We love the clean look of our standard Quest 3S, but Meta Quest 3S Xbox Edition is undeniably sleek in Xbox’s signature Carbon Black, while the Velocity Green accents lend the headset a subtle pop of color that’s unlike anything we’ve done before.

 We’re also including a carbon black Elite Strap in the box for increased comfort during your play sessions, plus matching Touch Plus controllers so you’ll have a fully color-coordinated setup for all your gaming needs.

 

 And for the first time ever, we’re including an Xbox controller with Quest as well (and in a limited edition colorway). While you can pair any Xbox Wireless Controller, Xbox Elite Wireless Controller Series 2, or Xbox Adaptive Controller to Quest using Bluetooth, this one comes pre-paired with the headset and shares the same look as the other accessories, with a Carbon Black chassis and Velocity Green highlights on the face buttons and analog sticks.

 Your Favorite Xbox Games Are Bigger Than Ever

 With the included Xbox controller, you’ll have all the hardware you need to unbox Meta Quest 3S Xbox Edition and immediately start playing your favorite Xbox games via the Xbox app on a massive 26-foot virtual display.

 

 The Xbox app lets Xbox Game Pass Ultimate members play hundreds of the biggest Xbox games, including day-one first-party releases, plus a selection of third-party hits that’s constantly refreshed.

 Games are streamed directly to your headset (meaning no waiting on a download), and you can choose from four different display sizes—including a massive theater-size screen (up to 26 feet) for full immersion. Play in an Xbox-themed immersive space for minimal distractions, or place the virtual screen right in your room.

 Using the Xbox app on Meta Quest 3S is great at home and also great for on-the-go gaming. No need to travel with your console. Throw Quest 3S in a backpack, and it’s like you’ve packed an entire home theater setup. All you need is the headset, controller, and a WiFi connection (20 Mbps or higher recommended), and you’ll be able to pick up from where you left off and enjoy your favorite Xbox games in a hotel, at your parents’ house, or wherever else life might take you. You can even play multiplayer cross-platform with people on an Xbox console.

 

 Xbox Cloud Gaming (Beta) requires an Xbox Game Pass Ultimate membership, so to get you started, Meta Quest 3S Xbox Edition includes three months of Xbox Game Pass Ultimate in the box—and don’t worry, if you’re already an Xbox Game Pass Ultimate member, those three months will stack on top of your existing time.*

 The Magic of Quest

 As part of our Quest 3 family, Quest 3S features Qualcomm’s powerful Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2 chip. Expect bleeding-edge performance, lightning-fast load times, and beautiful visuals that push what’s possible for a standalone headset. Meta Quest 3S also features full-color Passthrough, enabling you to seamlessly blend your physical surroundings with the virtual world and unlock a whole new type of content—including the ability to play your Xbox games on a larger-than-life screen, right in your living room. This bundle gives more people an opportunity to get their hands on this innovative device and enjoy the immersive experiences that we have to offer across the Meta Horizon Platform.
